weekSummary: Chicken thighs on special drive four hearty autumn dinners, with a slow pork shoulder rounding out the week

meals.name: Honey Soy Chicken Thighs with Rice
meals.description: Sticky glazed chicken thighs over steamed jasmine rice with bok choy
method: Mix soy sauce, honey, minced garlic and a splash of sesame oil in a bowl.
Score the chicken thighs and coat well in the marinade. Rest 10 minutes.
Heat a heavy pan over medium-high. Sear thighs skin-side down 6 minutes until deeply golden.
Flip, pour remaining marinade over, cover and cook 12 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile cook rice according to packet. Steam bok choy for 3 minutes.
Rest chicken 5 minutes, slice and serve over rice with bok choy and pan juices.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Shoulder
meals.description: Fall-apart pork shoulder with a smoky rub, served in soft rolls with coleslaw
method: Mix paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, salt and pepper into a dry rub.
Coat pork shoulder thoroughly with the rub. Refrigerate overnight if possible.
Place in slow cooker with half a cup of water. Cook on low 6 hours or high 4 hours.
Meanwhile shred cabbage and carrot finely. Dress with mayonnaise, salt, and a splash of vinegar.
When pork is fall-apart tender, shred with two forks directly in the cooker.
Pile into soft rolls and top generously with coleslaw.

meals.name: Chicken and Vegetable Stir Fry
meals.description: Quick weeknight stir fry with chicken breast, broccoli and capsicum over noodles
method: Slice chicken into thin strips. Toss with cornflour, salt and pepper.
Cut broccoli into small florets. Slice capsicum into strips.
Cook noodles per packet, drain and toss with a little oil.
Heat wok over high heat until smoking. Add oil, then chicken — cook 4 minutes without stirring.
Add vegetables and stir fry 3 minutes until just tender.
Pour in oyster sauce, soy sauce, and a splash of water. Toss everything together.
Serve over noodles.

meals.name: Pork Mince Fried Rice
meals.description: Savoury fried rice with pork mince, egg, corn and spring onion
method: Use day-old rice if possible — spread fresh rice on a tray and cool in fridge for an hour.
Cook pork mince in a hot wok with garlic and ginger until browned and slightly crispy.
Push mince to the side, scramble eggs in the centre.
Add rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir fry on high heat 3 minutes.
Add corn, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Toss to combine.
Finish with spring onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.

meals.name: Roast Chicken Drumsticks with Root Vegetables
meals.description: Crispy roast drumsticks with kumara, potato and onion — one-pan winter meal
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cut kumara, potato and onion into roughly equal chunks.
Toss vegetables in olive oil, salt, pepper and half the rosemary. Spread on a large roasting tray.
Rub drumsticks with olive oil, salt, pepper and remaining rosemary. Nestle on top of vegetables.
Roast 45–50 minutes, turning vegetables halfway, until chicken skin is crispy and vegetables are golden.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
